notes.title: ✨Our latest demo will be featured in Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Hello, dear player!

From October 14th to 21st, during the Steam Next Fest, we'll be bringing you the latest demo of ISOLAND PUMPKIN TOWN!

This demo includes the first room of the game. Since our game has an open format, the demo might be a bit short to avoid spoilers—please understand. Pumpkin Town is fascinating, with many connections to ISOLAND and Mr. Pumpkin. 

We highly recommend you download and try it out! We also have more surprises in store for you, including the latest news about our game release, improvements, new platforms, and more. Please stay tuned!

If you enjoy it, please add the game to your wishlist!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45197428/4a35577dd6dab66df534beec82dc1186abfb425d.png

Your feedback and support are our biggest motivation. Thank you so much for your continued support. We'll do our best to bring you the best content and look forward to moving forward together!

Cotton Game
